lead.headline: Campbell wins at Kansas State as a 16.5-point underdog
lead.deck: The Fighting Camels won on Kansas State's floor, then won at Coastal Carolina too. UNC Wilmington is 6-1 and first in the power rankings.
body: Campbell went to Kansas State as a 16.5-point underdog and won 80-70. Rashawn Inglemon and Lance Waddles scored 23 apiece, and the Camels beat the number by 26.5. Four nights later they won again at Coastal Carolina, 70-66 as 2-point underdogs, with Nordin Kapic scoring 21 and Waddles 19. The power rankings moved Campbell from ninth to third, the biggest climb in the league.

UNC Wilmington is the league's best team on paper and on the standings page. The Seahawks are 6-1, first in the power rankings and 139th in our model, the top CAA rating at plus-2.4 points per 100 possessions. They won 89-80 at Norfolk State as 11.5-point favorites, which didn't cover, and beat St. Thomas 86-77 as 5.5-point favorites. CJ Luster II scored 22 and 21, and Patrick Wessler had 20 points, 10 rebounds and five assists in Norfolk.

William & Mary is 6-2 after a three-game road-heavy week. The Tribe beat Averett 85-39, won 75-63 at Youngstown State as 2.5-point favorites behind Josh Baldwin's 23, and won 87-82 at IU Indianapolis, where Gavin Ward scored 25. They moved from seventh to fifth.

Towson fell the furthest. The Tigers rated highest in the league in our preseason edition; this week they lost 86-75 at American as 1-point underdogs and dropped from first to eighth in the power rankings. Zion Stanford scored 22 in the loss. They are 3-4.

The league went 13-11 and covered only nine of 23 lines, with one push. A lot of favorites won and didn't win by enough. Thanksgiving weekend brings the Ivy: Princeton at UNC Wilmington and Towson at Penn on Friday.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: A crowded weekend in Wilmington
body: **Princeton at UNC Wilmington, Friday, 3 p.m.** No line yet. Our model has the Seahawks by 6.5. Princeton just won at Liberty as an underdog, so this isn't a tune-up.
**Towson at Penn, Friday, 6 p.m.** No line yet. Penn is 143rd in our model, Towson 164th. The Tigers need a road win to stop the slide.
**William & Mary at James Madison, Sunday, 4 p.m.** No line yet. The Tribe have won three straight and close the holiday weekend on the road.

notes.headline: Rashad King's 38
notes.body: Northeastern lost 84-77 at Butler as a 16-point underdog, and Rashad King scored 38. He added 21 in a 95-82 loss at Stonehill, where the Huskies were 9-point favorites, and 23 in a 91-54 loss at Wisconsin. Northeastern is 2-5.

notes.headline: Tavari Johnson keeps scoring
notes.body: Charleston's guard, named the USBWA Oscar Robertson National Player of the Week per caasports.com, scored 32 in a 91-77 win over Kennesaw State. Martin Kalu added 22 and nine rebounds. The Cougars also lost 86-70 at Drake and 80-69 at home to UTEP as 2-point favorites.

notes.headline: Drexel's good night
notes.body: The Dragons beat Saint Joseph's 75-64 as 4.5-point underdogs, with LaDricus Pittman scoring 19. They lost 89-74 at Penn four days later.

notes.headline: Circle it: Liberty at UNC Wilmington
notes.body: Saturday, 3 p.m. ET. No line posted yet. Liberty is 127th in our model and UNCW 139th, the best pair of ratings meeting in a CAA gym this week.
